EC2: Medical illness unrelated to the tumor which in the opinion of the attending physician and principal investigator will preclude administration of the agent. This includes patients with uncontrolled infection [OR], chronic renal insufficiency [OR], myocardial infarction [OR] within the past 6 months, unstable angina [OR], cardiac arrhythmias [AND] [NOT] other than chronic atrial fibrillation [OR] and chronic active [OR] or persistent hepatitis [OR], or New York Heart Association [AND] Classification III or IV heart disease.
